conventions.payload_hex: the exact payload bytes, lowercase hex; the only input
conventions.payload_text: the same bytes as UTF-8 text for reading, or null when they are not valid UTF-8 or longer than 400 bytes; never an input
conventions.family: the topic whose sections give the payload's defined members (their JSON example keys and Field table names, with the Envelope Members keys), which hold for every object of the payload; null for a payload that names no family
conventions.expected: accept, or the reason a receiver refuses the payload for
conventions.families: every topic's defined members, sorted, for an implementation to compare its own with
